messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage for pediatric patients"
set: ["consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage for pediatric patients", "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage", "adult and pediatric patients", "for ADHD in pediatric patients", "consider duration of treatment", "patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the continued need of maintenance treatment", "review should determine the need for maintenance treatment", "used for acute and maintenance treatment of major depressive disorder", "pediatric patients 12 years and older with depression", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "for adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia", "consider dose reduction when used with bupropion", "early in treatment and when dose changes", "pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes", "patients who tolerate the 2.4 mg dosage for at least 4 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
